d: Solutions by stc is actively recruiting for the role of Solutions Manager - Service Delivery. In this role, you will be responsible for Managing Project Management activities for the Delivery of all B2B Customer Projects for “stc” & “solutions by stc” including Delivery, Commissioning, Installation, Closing and Handover.
r: Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:
Project Management & Delivery: Oversee all B2B customer projects, including critical Wholesale and US Army projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality standards, and customer satisfaction.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor project KPIs, identify areas for improvement, implement corrective actions, and provide regular progress reports to the Director.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers, vendors, and contractors to ensure smooth project execution and resolve delivery challenges.

Governance & Technical Support: Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and internal audit requirements while providing technical guidance and consultancy to Pre-Sales and Bid Management teams.
Team Leadership & Development: Set departmental objectives, align team KPIs, manage employee performance, and promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, coaching, and employee engagement.
